# MonProcessControl.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

HONOR&#39;s MonProcessControl.sys version 1.0.0.1 exposes process termination through IOCTL 0x22400C on \\.\MonProcessControl. Jehad Abudagga&#39;s KillerLand research publishes a proof of concept that submits a four-byte target PID and reports termination of protected AV/EDR processes. Static analysis confirms that the handler opens the supplied PID with ZwOpenProcess using a kernel handle and calls ZwTerminateProcess. The driver restricts device access to administrators and SYSTEM and checks that the calling process&#39;s image path ends with \HONOR\MagicAnimation\MagicSpaceTurbo.exe. The published proof of concept copies itself to that path before opening the device, satisfying this path-based check. Protected-process termination is reported by the researcher and was not independently reproduced here.
- **UUID**: de4bebdc-0f92-4855-989a-ac2cd1224190
- **Created**: 2026-10-19
- **Author**: Michael Haag
- **Acknowledgement**: Jehad Abudagga | [@j3h4ck](https://twitter.com/@j3h4ck)

### Commands

```
sc.exe create MonProcessControl binPath=C:\windows\temp\MonProcessControl.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start MonProcessControl
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Terminate caller-selected processes from kernel mode to impair security tools. | Administrator required to load the driver, access its device, and use the published proof of concept. | Windows |
